resources.string: Off until you turn it on. Records how the app fails, on this device only.
Nothing is recorded while this is off, and nothing was recorded before you turned it on.

What is recorded: the app and Android versions; how long the app takes to build its first screen; how many times playback finished and, in rough buckets, how long each session lasted; that playback failed, when it did; update checks and how they ended; and the crashes, freezes and other exits Android recorded for this app.

What is never recorded: audio, recordings, the names or contents of your mixes and presets, file paths, your location, contacts, device serial, advertising id or account, and no message text of any kind.
Where it goes: nowhere. Nightfall has no server and no code that uploads this. The only way it leaves your phone is if you open the report and share it yourself.
It stays on this device, capped at %1$d entries, %2$d kilobytes and %3$d days, and the oldest go first. Turn the switch off to stop recording, or erase it now.
The journal is erased. Nothing is left on this device.
This is the exact text the app holds, formatted so you can read it. Nothing here has been sent anywhere.
No app took the report. Nothing was sent.
